Tareeqa

Sirf 3 steps — baaqi sab hum sambhalte hain

Aapko technology samajhne ki bilkul zaroorat nahi. Aap bas khana banayein, order hum aap tak pohchayein ge.

1

Hum aapki page banate hain

Aap apna menu aur prices WhatsApp par bhej dein — hum aapki shop ki khoobsurat ordering page bana dein ge, bilkul upar wale demo jaisi.

2

Customer order karta hai

Page ka link apne Facebook, WhatsApp status aur shop par lagayein. Customer link khole, menu dekhe aur baghair app ke order kar de.

3

Order seedha aapke WhatsApp par

Poora order — items, total, naam, address — ek saaf message ki surat mein aapke WhatsApp par aa jata hai. Bas khana tayyar karein!

Faide

Har order par poora profit aapka

Foodpanda har order se lagbhag 25–30% kaat leta hai. Rs 1,000 ke order par Rs 250–300 unka. Menutap par? Sifar.

0% Commission

Jo kamaya, sab aapka. Foodpanda ke 25–30% ke muqable mein Menutap har order par sifar commission leta hai — sirf fixed mahina fee.

Customer ko app nahi chahiye

Page seedha browser mein khulti hai — link par tap, menu hazir. Koi download nahi, koi sign-up nahi, is liye zyada order.

Order seedha aapke WhatsApp par

Wohi WhatsApp jo aap roz chalate hain. Items, total, naam, address — sab ek saaf message mein. Na naya system seekhna, na order miss.

Menu updates shamil hain

Price badalni hai? Naya item dalna hai? Bas WhatsApp par bata dein — 24 ghante ke andar page update, mahina fee mein shamil.

Sawalaat

Aksar poochay jane wale sawal

Kya customer ko app download karni pare gi? +
Bilkul nahi. Page seedha phone ke browser mein khulti hai — customer link par tap kare, menu dekhe aur order kar de. Koi app nahi, koi sign-up nahi.
Mujhe technology nahi aati — main kaise chalaon ga? +
Aapko kuch seekhne ki zaroorat hi nahi. Page banana, lagana, update karna — sab hum karte hain. Aap bas apne WhatsApp par aaya hua order dekhein aur khana tayyar karein.
Menu ya price badalni ho to? +
Bas humein WhatsApp par message kar dein. Menu aur price ki updates aapki mahina fee mein shamil hain aur aam tor par 24 ghante ke andar ho jati hain.
Kya main kabhi bhi band kar sakta hoon? +
Ji haan — service month-to-month hai, koi lamba contract nahi. Pasand na aaye to agle mahine se band kar dein. Aur shuru karne se pehle 7 din ka free trial bhi hai.
